reviewer: independent read-only G7 handoff boundary review

findings.title: Independent G7-to-G8 handoff review could miss case-variant private or routing metadata keys
findings.evidence: scripts/review_g7_g8_handoff.py::find_forbidden used exact case-sensitive membership and omitted verifier_ref, eligible_u, u_ineligibility_reason, and routing metadata. The executable G7 runner already treats these as forbidden, so the independent audit could under-report a boundary violation.
findings.remediation: Align the independent recursive key check with the complete runner boundary using case-insensitive matching; retain ordinary public prose as allowed text.
